title: Fleet Rung 35 — THE HUMAN CADENCE (one moment, one owner): the social activity measured robotic on-chain and is replaced by persona-owned windows, desk-truth content, engagement floors, internal-only law, and the equal-share delegation — the fleet stops reading as a machine so it can one day speak in public.
operator: owner directive (2026-10-04, Hebrew, verbatim anchors): the soldiers' posts/votes are 'very mechanical, very robotic, pointless and valueless... today it is easy to see it is done by AI'; 'there are broken posts. there are posts repeating themselves'; 'everyone votes at the same moment, everyone posts at the same moment... it will hurt us a lot over time'; 'ensure the sovereignty transfers and handles delegating power to the soldiers equally so we receive the full voting power at the end, and full activity power for every soldier'; 'try to open us a dedicated community on Steem'; 'for now we work only with ourselves... if for now we work only around our group that will be the best'; 'I want to make sure we are better than everyone and behave exemplarily like the best users, for everyone and for us.'

measured_diagnosis.burst_timing: on-chain account history (2026-10-04): 10 posts in one workflow run ~500ms apart; cross-votes at exact 18-21s cadence in a fixed account order (00:54:57→00:55:51, 01:48:18→01:51:27); follow custom_jsons at exact 3s intervals (22:43:42→22:43:48); all social activity in 2-3 daily windows.
measured_diagnosis.content_robotica: one shared wheel of 39 knowledge-cards (all network/ops meta) across 10 persona accounts; every post the same skeleton (bold title repeat, {desk}-desk opener, card body, hr, the SAME fleet-stats line in 4 variants, rotating signoff pool); '(measured DATE)' title stamps; personas never write their desks (old maps/knots/news), they write infrastructure.
measured_diagnosis.broken_posts: cashmachine posted 'SAOS WEB probe B' with body 'probe B' on-chain; it then collected 11 fleet votes — the cross-vote engine votes ALL sibling posts with no substance floor.
measured_diagnosis.power_imbalance: owner 3810.58 SP effective vs soldiers 30-33 SP each (the 30 SP delegation); head delegates only 380 SP of 3946.7 own SP; powerdown 476 SP/week from 2026-10-10 is the self-funding battery and must coexist with any delegation expansion.

queries.Q29_why_windows_not_random_delays: A random sleep inside ONE run still ships the run together and looks bursty to any observer. The slot map gives each soldier personal hours (wic writes early 05-07 UTC, cashmachine at market hours, wog at night), seeded per-day jitter inside the window, quiet hours 00:00-04:59 UTC, and catch-up windows (blog window = first hour..last hour+2) so a starved runner lands human-late instead of machine-clustered. Caps per invocation (2 posts, 2 social soldiers, 3 curate soldiers) make a full catch-up physically unable to reproduce the old burst.
queries.Q30_what_makes_the_content_human: Desk truth: 40 hand-written pieces in content-library.json, each with its OWN shape (essays, lists, field notes, five-lines), each belonging to exactly one desk. No shared openers/closers, no fleet statistics in soldier posts, no measured-stamps, no card wheel. The content gate machine-checks the tells: em-dashes, AI-phrase markers, probe/test words, bodies under 400 chars, ops words in bodies, hub tag presence. Reuse cooldown: the same piece not within 14 days for the same soldier.
queries.Q31_what_stops_another_probe_b: THE PROBE-B LAW, encoded twice: (1) the content gate refuses to publish probe/short junk; (2) candidateEligible makes any fleet post with body < 800 chars invisible to votes, comments and reblogs — junk can no longer collect fleet support, even our own junk.
queries.Q32_why_internal_only: Owner directive: 'for now we work only with ourselves' — until the quality bar lifts, comments/votes/reblogs target fleet posts only (candidateEligible rejects non-fleet authors; soldiers-curate requires CURATE_SCOPE=external for outside discovery). The saos trailing tag makes steemit.com/created/saos the fleet's internal clubhouse surface. No external engagement, no spam risk while the content grows up.
queries.Q33_what_is_the_equal_share_law: head-delegate v2: target per soldier = floor((own SP - powerdown committed - RC reserve 500) / 10), floor 30 SP. Today: (3946.7 - 0 - 500)/10 = 344 SP per soldier (x11 vote value and VP regen). As the powerdown commits capital weekly, the target glides down and delegations follow (reclaim = broadcast the smaller absolute value, hysteresis band 5%). Social power and market fuel coexist by arithmetic, never by hand-tuning.
queries.Q34_what_happens_to_the_legacy_engines: soldiers-blog, fleet-social, self-audience (soldier lanes) and soldiers-curate defer when persona-slots v2 exists (FORCE_LEGACY=1 overrides for one-off runs); self-audience.yml loses the blog and social steps and keeps claims/delegation/doctor; human-cadence.yml runs hourly at :13 and owns blog+curate+social. The community ACCOUNT creation (digest hub with its own keys) is booked as the next rung — it needs a key ceremony, not a rush.
queries.Q35_coordination_to_sibling_lanes: The cadence desk is Domain-side and self-contained: persona-slots.json is law-as-data, human-cadence.cjs is the single writer of its books, the hourly workflow carries the same SA_FLEET_KEYS secret (no new material). E47's sovereignty bar re-based IN THE OPEN (49→50 files, 33→34 owner-secret, keyless 16 unchanged). The market lane is untouched: sovereign-trade-loop, market-exec and the VWAP/edge laws keep their rungs; owner's RC reserve (500 SP) protects the MM ops from the delegation drift.
